title: 483. Longest Palindrome

examples.explanation: Rearrange to dccaccd, which reads the same both ways.
A single letter is already a palindrome.
Upper and lower case are distinct, so only one can be used.

hints: Count how many times each letter appears; case matters.
Pairs of equal letters can sit symmetrically on both sides.
At most one leftover single can sit in the center.
